(I)--the eldest son of Ugrasena
1: भा. IX. २४. २४; Br.

-११, ६७-69; 3. 2; chap. 4.
An incarnation of कालनेमि. Threw his father Ugra- sena in prison and assumed regal administration.
3: भा.

. ६८-69.
Encouraged by his Asura friends such as Pralamba and Baka, as also by the मागधन् king, he tyrannized the Yadus who left the land for other countries like Kuru, पाञ्- चाल and others. The ब्राह्मणस् were afraid of him.
4: Ib.

-4; २३. ५२.
Heard from नारद that कृष्ण and बलराम were Vasudeva's sons; when he went to slay Vasudeva, नारद prevented him from it. He then threw Vasudeva and his wife in prison. He summoned his councillors and asked the Mallas, चाणूर and मुष्टिक to get ready for a wrestling match with कृष्ण and राम; ordered his mahout to station the State Elephant at the gate of the enclosure (रङ्ग) and get कृष्ण and राम trampled under its feet; when he was asked why he was out to kill those two boys, he narrated the story of his mother once going in the garden thinking of her husband Ugrasena. Then a Gandharva Drumila per- sonated Ugrasena. Discovering that he was not her hus- band, she asked him in wrath who he was. He tried to console her saying that she would give birth to a heroic son. The chaste lady retorted that he would be cruel and un- righteous. Such being his birth, he hated his kith and kin. Then he commanded to commence the धनुर्याग। अक्रूर was sent for and ordered to take his chariot and bring कृष्ण and राम to the धनुर्याग with all gopas. He proposed to kill all of them and rule the kingdoms with the help of friends like जरासन्ध. Thanked by अक्रूर for an opportunity to visit कृष्ण and राम; अक्रूर reached the Vraja and was welcomed by the brothers and Nanda. Informed of their arrival by अक्रूर. Much concerned to know of the breaking of his bow by कृष्ण and further the killing of his guards. He had no sleep all night and had bad dreams, all in fear of कृष्ण. Next morning he drove [page१-294+ ३६] to the wrestling ground and occupied the royal seat with his ministers; was perturbed to learn of the death of Kuva- लयापीड and its guards. Became furious at the death of his five mallas and the running away of others. Ordered the banishment of the two brothers, robbing the gopas of their belongings, and imprisonment of Nanda, killing of Ugrasena and Vasudeva. कृष्ण attacked him direct, pull- ed him down from his throne and killed him. His eight brothers who offered fight were slain by राम.

Attained Hari through fear.
१०: भा.

. ३०.
Of the Bhoja family. Funeral rites done by Ugrasena.
११: Vi. V. २१. 7-१०; २९. 5.
(II)--a दानव king; with the sun for two months--मधु and माधव। Br. II. २३. 3; IV. २९. १२३.
--a daughter of Ugrasena; married देवभाग. भा. IX. २४. २५ and ४०; Br. III. ७१. १३४; M. ४४. ७५; Vi. IV. १४. २१.
--a daughter of Ugrasena. Married Deva- श्रवस्. भा. IX. २४. २५ & ४१; Br. III. ७१. १३४; M. ४४. ७५; Vi. IV. १४. २१. [page१-295+ २९]
(II)--a son of Durmada (Durdama-मत्स्य प्।); father of कृतवीर्य and three other sons, कार्तवीर्य, कृत- varma and कृत. Br. III. ६९. 8; M. ४३. १२; वा. ९४. 7-9.
(V)--a king who ruled over स्त्रीराष्ट्र, Bho- jaka and other kingdoms. Br. III. ७४. १९९.
--R. a महानदी, remembered by लोमश per- forming penance at the मुण्दपृष्ट hill; fit for performance of श्राद्ध। वा. १०८. ८०.
(I)--enjoy kingdoms of त्रैराज्य and मूषिक. Vi. IV. २४. ६७.
--a sacred place (तीर्थ); a bather here goes to heaven, relieved of all three ऋणस्; east of the मुण्डपृष्ट hill. Br. III. १३. ११३-5; वा. ७७. १०५.

--(Mt.) from the अण्ड;
1: वा. २४. ७५.
ten thousand योजनस् in length, containing caves of red arsenic.
2: वा. ३५. १०.
[page१-306+ २६]
--a son of Pulaha and क्षमा; wife यशो- धरा and son सहिष्णु. Br. II. ११. ३१.
--His wife was met by Agni, and Nala was their son. Br.
--one of the forms of ब्रह्मा in the Gaya stone. वा. १०६. ५६; १११. ७२.
--a sacred place on the Ganges, where गरुड performed तपस्। Here शिव danced with a योगिनी. Bath here leads to Rudralokam. M. १८६. १०; १९२. ११; १९३. ६९-71; वा. ८३. २१.
--a तीर्थ in Gaya; on its right side is Dak- षिणमानस. वा. १११. 7. [page१-307+ २३]
--one of the five deva-गणस् of the १४थ् epoch of Bhautya Manu. These are the seven सामस् commencing with बृहत्। Br.
--one of the ten sons of हृदीक. M. ४४. ८२.
--an attribute of Manmatha. Br. IV. १९. ६७; ३०. ५४ and ८५; M. १५४. २५०.
--a game with balls indulged in by girls. मोहिनी played it. भा. VIII. १२. १८ & २३; M. १६०. 4.
(II)--daughter of Kardama and wife of Priya- vrata; mother of two daughters and ten sons. Vi.
(III)--shrine of, south of Malaya {??}ills, visited by बलराम. भा. X. ७९. १७.
--the harem of a palace. Vi. V. २९. ३१.
--a fearful forest between the hills पुष्- पकशैल and महामेघ. वा. ३८. ७१-8.
--the son of Devadatta alias अग्निवेश्य. He was the sage जातूकर्णिज (जातुकर्ण-Burnouf). He was a mani- festation of Fire God. With him originated the Brahma- kula-आग्निवेश्यायन. भा.
--one of the ten branches of the सुकर्मण group of devas. Br.
--The sacred pool of, protected by किरातस्. Br. III. १३. ९५-7.
--leads to the world of विष्णु. M. १०१. ४५.
